blocks.text: Tom Skerritt, the Emmy-winning actor whose film and television career spanned over six decades, has died at age 93.

Skerritt broke into mainstream prominence with Robert Altman’s M*A*S*H (1970) and early TV guest roles on series like Hawaii Five-O, Gunsmoke and Bonanza . He starred as Captain Dallas in Ridley Scott’s Alien (1979) and Commander “Viper” Metcalf in Top Gun (1986). His wide-ranging film work featured memorable roles in Harold and Maude , Steel Magnolias , A River Runs Through It , Contact , and Bonneville .

blocks.text: On television, Skerritt won an Emmy Award as Sheriff Jimmy Brock in the drama Picket Fences and made appearances on shows ranging from Cheers to Madam Secretary .
